task.goal: A deployment CLI accepts --label VALUE, --quiet, and -- to end option parsing. An explicitly empty label is treated as absent, and filenames after -- are parsed as flags. Fix parse_args(argv) in options.py. Preserve the returned dictionary shape, run visible tests and validate.

result.text:
I'll start by inspecting the workspace.Both bugs are visible: `if argv[index]:` drops an explicitly empty label, and `--` is treated as an unknown option (so later filenames never reach `files`).Fixed `parse_args` in options.py: `--` now ends option parsing and every remaining token is collected into `files` verbatim (so filenames shaped like flags survive), and an explicitly empty `--label` value is stored as `""` instead of being discarded to `None`. No other form of the returned dict changed; `--quiet`, unknown-option errors, and the missing-value `ValueError` are untouched.

`python -m unittest -v test_options` passes both visible tests, covering the empty-label case and `--`-terminated filenames.
